comment: R-em3d24-4b. Upstream's published 64-bit Windows archive for the validated release (2026-10-09). Its digest is GitHub's, published with the release asset. It prints the tags (openEMS v0.37.0, CSXCAD v0.7.0) rather than the hashes 305df56 and c46e320, which the tags pin exactly, so SolverDiscovery's validated entry accepts both spellings (as found at the first Windows install of the release candidate, 2026-09-30).
layoutNote: Upstream's binary archive: the programs load their libraries from beside themselves, so the home is built in .partial and renamed into place.
